name: restaurant-management-system
description: This is a Real-Time Restaurant Management & Point of Sale (POS) System designed to digitize and automate restaurant operations. It eliminates paper order slips by enabling customers to place orders via table-specific QR codes. Orders are instantly routed to a real-time Kitchen Display System, while inventory is tracked automatically to prevent overselling.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
